section_2_engineering_excellence.successes: Implements a multi-stage python:3.11-slim Dockerfile (deployment/Dockerfile:1-48) that compiles dependencies in a builder stage, strips apt lists, runs as dedicated non-root appuser:appgroup (UID 1000, line 39), and pairs with right-sized Cloud Run limits (2 vCPU, 2GiB RAM, scale-to-zero min_instances=0 in cloudrun.tf:30-43).
section_2_engineering_excellence.failures_and_gaps: deployment/Dockerfile:36 copies the entire evals/ directory into the production runtime image (/app/evals), and Dockerfile:45 points HEALTHCHECK to /health whereas Cloud Run startup/liveness probes in cloudrun.tf:86,97 target /healthz.
section_2_engineering_excellence.reasoning: Awarded Score 3 (Proficient/Expert) for multi-stage slim containerization, strict non-root UID 1000 execution, dependency layer separation, and right-sized serverless Cloud Run CPU/memory allocation with scale-to-zero efficiency.

section_2_engineering_excellence.name: AI Cost Management
section_2_engineering_excellence.criteria: Evaluates model selection trade-offs, manages token budgeting and query filtering to minimize database bytes scanned, and models infrastructure/inference costs.
section_2_engineering_excellence.successes: Enforced maximum_bytes_billed (50 MB per-query cost circuit breaker) on BigQuery QueryJobConfig and implemented a thread-safe TTL + LRU CatalogResponseCache (catalog_cache) that serves repeat catalog lookups in <0.05ms with 0 bytes billed.
section_2_engineering_excellence.failures_and_gaps: Cache coherence trade-off: A 300-second in-memory TTL cache means intra-minute price updates in BigQuery may take up to 5 minutes to reflect on repeat identical queries.
section_2_engineering_excellence.reasoning: Score 3 (Expert): BigQuery queries are protected by both a hard 50 MB maximum_bytes_billed guardrail and a thread-safe TTL/LRU response cache.
